scope: Prospective replacement of 12 public Viewer Office fixture binaries; not authority to redistribute existing or replacement bytes.
global_release_gates: Acquire, independently review and retain an exact candidate binary set whose SHA-256 matches one named provenance JSON artifact and whose toolchain versions are recorded.
Verify the 12 candidate-file notices, content and embedded components, including opaque legacy streams and inherited Office templates, for the intended redistribution.
Document explicit release approval for the exact proposed bytes from a rights-authorised owner or qualified reviewer; never infer approval from CI.
Replace only in a separately reviewed change with a new fixture inventory and unchanged Office/security regression coverage.

Recognise that replacing tracked files in HEAD does not remove historical blobs from Git history, forks, caches or existing clones; assess remediation and communication separately before any history rewrite.
historical_git_history_exposure: PRESENT: prior public commits continue to hold the existing 12 fixture blobs; altering HEAD alone does not retract them.
